full_judgment: 9. Mr. Muhammad Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing on behalf of the appellant made submission in the light of the grounds of appeal upon which leave was granted. In particular, he emphasized that during the examination under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure the attention of the accused was not drawn to the statement which he made to the Magistrate which was recorded under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
